compute_vjp: compute the vector-Jacobian product of a function with respect to primal tensor inputs
compute_jacobian_reverse_mode: compute the Jacobian of a function using reverse-mode autodiff with jacrev
compute_jacobian_forward_mode: compute the Jacobian of a function using forward-mode autodiff with jacfwd
compute_jvp: compute the Jacobian-vector product of a function using forward-mode autodiff with jvp
compute_gradient: compute the gradient of a scalar-output function with respect to specified input arguments using grad
